newsitem.title: INDIA: Daimler to raise stake in India unit.
newsitem.headline: Daimler to raise stake in India unit.

text.p: Mercedes-Benz India Ltd (MBIL) on Thursday confirmed that India had approved a proposal for Germany's Daimler-Benz AG to raise its stake in its local joint venture to 76 percent from 51 percent.

MBIL Vice-President Finance Prakash Kedar told Reuters by telephone from Bombay that an earlier statement from India's Industry Ministry about an additional injection of 1.78 billion rupees ($49.7 million) by Daimler-Benz followed approval some weeks ago by the Foreign Investment Promotion Board (FIPB).
"We do not manufacture anything in India," Kedar said in reference to the Industry Ministry's mention of "existing car engines" in its announcement.
"Engines are imported from Germany along with the CKD (completely knocked-down) kits for Mercedes-Benz cars," Kedar said. "This approval relates to an increase in share capital."
He said MBIL's authorised share capital is 3.5 billion rupees and with the additional investment Daimler-Benz's shareholding will rise to 2.66 billion rupees, or 76 percent.
"This approval has nothing to do with car engines," Kedar added.
He said the infusion of new capital by Daimler-Benz would reduce Tata Engineering and Locomotive Co Ltd's (TELCO) stake in the joint venture to 24 percent from 49 percent.

MBIL said on June 2 that the joint-venture partners had agreed that "in view of TELCO's investment commitments to its own business growth" the Indian firm would not take part in the current capital increase.
"TELCO retains the option to subscribe to future equity share capital increases and maintain its shareholding percentage," MBIL said.
Mercedes-Benz India is moving its factory to a newly-designed and TELCO-constructed plant at Chikhali, near the TELCO plant in the western city of Pune.

Last April Mercedes-Benz India said it had taken over marketing of its cars from TELCO, which is India's leading truck maker. Mercedes said it planned to set up an efficient and exclusive dealer network throughout India with special focus on after-sales service.
